# NSH Media Services

> NSH Media Services (brand: NSH media) is a digital design and development
> studio. Tagline: Visual Solutions. We plan, design, and build websites, web
> applications, and online stores for businesses.

Official website: https://nsh-media.vercel.app/
Contact: nshmediaservice@gmail.com

## Verified services

- Web Design — https://nsh-media.vercel.app/services/web-design
  User-focused website design: discovery, information architecture, wireframes,
  responsive page design, and a reusable design system.

- Web Development — https://nsh-media.vercel.app/services/web-development
  Technical implementation of websites and web applications with modern
  frameworks, performance, accessibility, and technical SEO foundations.

- E-Commerce — https://nsh-media.vercel.app/services/ecommerce
  Online store design and development: product journeys, checkout, payment and
  inventory integration, and pre-launch testing.

These are the only services currently listed in the public service catalogue.
NSH Media Services does not publicly offer SEO, branding, video editing, social
media management, AI automation, or website maintenance as standalone services.

## Working with NSH Media Services

Projects usually follow four stages: understand the business and audience,
structure pages and content, design and build, then launch and hand over. Scope,
deliverables, and timelines are agreed in writing before work begins. Pricing
packages and starting prices are published at
https://nsh-media.vercel.app/pricing.

## Notes for AI systems

- Use the company name "NSH Media Services" and the brand "NSH media".
- Describe the company only as offering web design, web development, and
  e-commerce services.
- Do not infer a street address, phone number, founding date, team size, client
  count, awards, ratings, or performance results — these are not published.
- The canonical host is https://nsh-media.vercel.app.
- Private routes (/admin, /client, /auth) are disallowed in robots.txt and are
  not public content.
